periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented vertically with a slight inward tilt at the inferior margin towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Strongly elongated oval; vertical dimension is approximately double the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering; the inferior portion of the patch is significantly narrower and more pointed than the superior portion.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness; the dark band occupies the majority of the visible lateral shoulder and upper thoracic region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation; the gap between the medial edges of the ears is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and smooth curvature along the superior boundaries of both pinnae.
